edit.description: unbacked import guidance names a trailing `.` as part of the path

summary: An `@path` import takes the documented backslash-space escape and keeps trailing punctuation literal; its unbacked finding says a trailing `.` is part of the path
acceptance: `@Design\ Docs/api.md` imports `Design Docs/api.md`; `See @a.md.` stays `a.md.` and its unbacked finding names the trailing period
tests: a backslash escaped space continues a memory import path
an unbacked import ending in a period says the period is part of the path
pins: a trailing period stays part of a memory import path
notes: 0101 instance. Escape: code.claude.com/docs/en/memory, 'Import additional files' (retrieved 2026-11-25): 'Without the backslashes, the path ends at the first space'. Docs silent on trailing punctuation, so the literal bytes bind; stripping it is rejected in 0101. Build confirms which module carries the unbacked-import message (graph.rs or gate.rs).
